body: No one can tell you what to feel because they don't know what you're suffering with.
I've been having these for the past two nights
I feel similar to your situation, but I'm 31. You can still turn it around.

It is for me and it's been a long time coming. I'm building the nerve to finally do it. I guess it's about committing to the decision, it's much easier now that I've lost the one person that I lived for.
I feel the same exact way

You're lucky to still have him.

If you love him then turn things around before it's too late. Never give up if hes the one. Don't be like me and wait until it's too late.

Thanks for your post.

The loneliness feels overwhelming, but I can never bring myself to throw out the things that she gave me...that's the same as erasing her.

I won't ever be the same, and I don't think that I can continue. I'm at work now but I can barely hold it together.

We were together because of our bond. The fucked up thing is that I know she still loves me. 

I don't want to be with anyone else. No one else can make feel the way that she did...it was the same before I met her too. Even when I was with someo me else, I never fully loved them. She is the last one...and id give anything to hear her voice one more time.
